# Prepared material joins recurrent chain formation

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`recurrent-chain-assembly` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F10 · [record](recurrent-chain-assembly.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Where every unit draws d from one stock and becomes two, n rounds from k units run exactly when the stock covers d·k(2^n − 1), ending with k·2^n units; from k mature chains with the pool holding the rounds' blocks, n rounds reach k·2^n mature chains exactly when the support covers 9k(2^n − 1).

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. For every alphabet with decidable equality and every law of draws, a copy of a word makes its product what was built followed by the word exactly when the pool supplies the word and the support covers what its attachments draw. (`Becoming.Copying.built_iff`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
2. Where every unit draws d from one stock and becomes two, n rounds from k units with stock m run exactly when d·k(2^n − 1) ≤ m, ending with k·2^n units and m − d·k(2^n − 1) of the stock, and they run wherever the stock covers that; k(2^n − 1), what the rounds draw for beyond the start, with the k units of the start makes k·2^n. (`Becoming.Copying.required`, `Becoming.Copying.required_add`, `Becoming.Copying.doubling`, `Becoming.Copying.doubling_iff`, `Becoming.Copying.doubling_runs`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
3. In the chain machine, end attachment of up to eight tokens is the core copy of the alternating word with unit draws: within the size limit a chain grows by the alternating word exactly when the pool supplies that word and the support covers one unit per token; attachment keeps a chain's bonds the path on its tokens, so a chain so bonded grows exactly so, bonds included. (`Becoming.CopyingInstances.alternatingFrom`, `Becoming.CopyingInstances.grow_view`, `Becoming.CopyingInstances.grow_iff`, `Becoming.CopyingInstances.attach_path_shaped`, `Becoming.CopyingInstances.grow_path_shaped`, `Becoming.CopyingInstances.grow_strand_iff`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* not measured: none of its declarations is in the spine run the measure reads.
4. From the empty chain the mature chain of eight alternating tokens forms, bonds included, exactly when the pool holds at least four of each kind and at least eight units of support are free. (`Becoming.CopyingInstances.mature_forms_iff`, `Becoming.CopyingInstances.mature_strand_iff`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* not measured: none of its declarations is in the spine run the measure reads.
5. Each attachment and each cleavage draws one unit, so the support used grows by the tokens added plus the chains added, in one reproduction and over rounds. From k mature chains with the blocks for n rounds in the pool, the rounds reach k·2^n mature chains exactly when the free support covers 9k(2^n − 1), that is, exactly when doubling with draw 9 runs n rounds from k units and the free support. (`Becoming.CopyingInstances.reproduce_used`, `Becoming.CopyingInstances.rounds_used`, `Becoming.CopyingInstances.rounds_mature_iff`, `Becoming.CopyingInstances.rounds_follow_doubling`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* not measured: none of its declarations is in the spine run the measure reads.
6. With the blocks for n rounds and any tail in the pool and the free support raised by 9k(2^n − 1), n rounds from k mature chains give k·2^n mature chains, leaving the tail and the free support, the sufficient side; in the machine's own count k(2^n − 1) and k make k·2^n, and every course of rounds keeps the tokens in chains and pool together and the free and used support together. (`RecurrentAssembly.supported_rounds`, `RecurrentAssembly.required_as_growth`, `RecurrentAssembly.rounds_accounts`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* not measured: none of its declarations is in the spine run the measure reads.
7. Where routing the eight-slot recipe from a pool completes with nothing left, the routed output with the blocks for n rounds and any tail in the pool and 9(2^n − 1) + 8 more units of free support forms the mature chain and then 2^n mature chains, leaving the tail and the free support. (`RecurrentAssembly.prepared_repeated_generation`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* not measured: none of its declarations is in the spine run the measure reads.
8. The mature chain's tokens and bonds are those of the earlier fragmentation chain, and cleaving it at its centre leaves two alternating fragments of four that keep their internal bonds, the earlier chain's cut components. (`RecurrentAssembly.formed_graph_matches_previous`, `RecurrentAssembly.fragments_retain_real_links`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* not measured: none of its declarations is in the spine run the measure reads.
9. In witnesses: two rounds from one mature chain with the blocks for three chains and 27 units of support give four mature chains, while with 26 the last successor has seven components, all material kept; and from a pool of eight tokens of one kind with eight units, growth stalls after one token with seven units free. (`RecurrentAssembly.two_generations_realized`, `RecurrentAssembly.partial_failure_keeps_material`, `RecurrentAssembly.missing_kind_stalls_with_work_remaining`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* not measured: none of its declarations is in the spine run the measure reads.

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- A/B end compatibility, central cleavage of an eight-component path and operation order are supplied; the completed routing output has no unrepresented load-bearing edges.
- Continuing one complete chain for g rounds requires 8(2^g−1) additional components and 9(2^g−1) support; structural activation from routed material additionally requires eight support units.
- The core laws hold for every alphabet with decidable equality and every law of draws; the machine's tokens are Boolean, its chains at most eight tokens long, its counts of tokens and support natural numbers.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Heritable variation of the organizing laws, physical mechanics, an autonomous feed and a broad comparative advantage do not follow from these laws.
- The attachment route and the earlier division growth correspond only at the checked endpoint.
- **Counterexample:** One missing support unit leaves a real seven-component successor; absence of B stalls despite remaining work. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/universal-ethics/RecurrentAssembly.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise is used. The core declarations use no Lean axiom; the periphery declarations cited use only Lean's standard axioms (propext, Quot.sound, Classical.choice), as their receipts report. · Stated for discrete steps. · Uses decidability of the named determinations, a logical commitment written as a hypothesis. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation.
